addendum_content_raw:
VII.1 and 2. - Investments and Trusts. On 04/09/2010, my only remaining stock in my IRA, Exxon Mobile-Common Stock, was sold and the proceeds were

rolled-over to my Federal Thrift Savings Plan (TSP) retirement account. The 04/30/2010 report from the broker indicates that the values for "Total Cost Basis"

and "Unrealized Gain/Loss" for this stock (again, the proceeds from which were rolled over to my TSP account) are "Unavailable." Therefore, | am unable to

complete Part D. (4).
